date.as_written: samvat 821 phālguṇakṛṣṇatrayodaśī ... samvat 823 bhādrapadakṛṣṇanavami puṣyanakṣatra bṛhaspativāra

notes: The colophon contains two dated event records: (1) NS 821 Phālguna kṛṣṇa 13 marking the Ākāśamahābhairava chariot consecration performed by King Jayabhūpatīndramalla; (2) NS 823 Bhādrapada kṛṣṇa 9 Puṣya nakṣatra Thursday marking the consecration of the Gaṇabhalali temple also performed by him.
